Hi Natalie —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call this morning. As discussed, your procurement team prefers a short, documented onboarding refresh ahead of the new term so the vendor recertification step is seamless. To keep timelines tight (renewal effective 2028-01-01) here’s what I recommend we do:

1) Redwood provides a short evidence bundle (SOC2 extract, infrastructure contacts, and current SLA amendment) by EOD Thu 10/21.
2) HavenHealth completes the vendor questionnaire and confirms PO workflow by Tue 10/26.
3) We run a quick procurement portal handoff (15–30m) with your procure-ops team the week of 10/25.

I’ve attached a vendor-onboarding checklist and SOC2 extract for your procurement reviewers. If this timeline looks OK, I’ll loop in our legal/finance ops for the PO path and DocuSign routing.

Open questions for you:
- Do you need Redwood to pre-fill any fields in your procurement portal?
- Who at HavenHealth will sign for the PO (name/email)?

Thanks — aim is to avoid a manual recert cycle at renewal and keep the capacity increase (we discussed the +25% cushion) on the same PO.

Best,

We’re aiming to have the PO ready by 10/28 if Redwood provides the pre-fill details and the security contact. Happy to run the portal handoff on 10/26 — midmorning preferred.
